hero.title: Medicine that takes time for you
hero.lead: We take time to know you: your story, your life and what you have been carrying, not just your symptoms.
hero.body: Because hormones, metabolism and micronutrients are one connected system, we look at the whole picture, backed by more than 35 years of experience across many medical fields and current research. You leave understood, informed and hopeful, with a doctor who stays close by your side.

pillars.title: The four pillars of our approach

items.title: Time to know you
items.body: Your story, your life and your wellbeing, not just your lab results. Our first consultation takes 60 minutes.

items.title: Everything is connected
items.body: Hormones, metabolism and micronutrients, looked at as one system, so your whole body is being understood.

items.title: Experience across many fields
items.body: More than 35 years in general medicine, research, psycho-oncology, surgery, acupuncture and orthomolecular medicine, combined with gynaecology training and current research on hormones and metabolism.

items.title: You leave empowered
items.body: Understood, informed and hopeful, with a doctor who stays close by your side.

founder.quote: My mission is to help women take back control of their health and feel like themselves again.
